title: Communication-Efficient Clustered Federated Learning in Non-IID Wireless Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.38970v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current and emerging mobile networks face increasing privacy, scalability, and performance challenges as distributed learning becomes essential for advanced 6G services. These challenges are amplified by the presence of non-IID data, naturally arising in heterogeneous wireless environments, that degrade the performance of standard Federated Learning (FL) approaches. To address non-IID data across clients, we propose a Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) framework that assigns clients to specialized models during training. Data-domain clustering initializes model-based clustering, enabling identification and exploitation of client similarities without sharing raw data while reducing communication cost.   Motivated by mmWave beam selection, we evaluate our methods on a wireless simulation dataset (DeepMIMO) and complement it with two non-IID benchmarks (FEMNIST, Rotated CIFAR-10) to isolate different non-IID characteristics. translated_title: 非独立同分布无线网络中的通信高效聚类联邦学习
translated_abstract: 随着分布式学习成为先进6G服务的关键技术，当前和新兴的移动网络面临着日益严峻的隐私、可扩展性和性能挑战。异构无线环境中自然产生的非独立同分布数据会降低标准联邦学习（FL）方法的性能，从而进一步加剧了这些挑战。为解决客户端之间的非独立同分布数据问题，我们提出了一种聚类联邦学习（CFL）框架，该框架在训练过程中将客户端分配到专门的模型。数据域聚类用于初始化基于模型的聚类，从而在无需共享原始数据的情况下识别并利用客户端之间的相似性，同时降低通信成本。受毫米波波束选择问题的启发，我们在无线仿真数据集（DeepMIMO）上评估了所提出的方法，并用两个非独立同分布基准数据集（FEMNIST、Rotated CIFAR-10）加以补充，以隔离不同的非独立同分布特性。
tldr: 提出了一种通信高效的聚类联邦学习框架，通过数据域聚类初始化基于模型的聚类，在不共享原始数据的前提下识别客户端相似性并为其分配专门模型，从而解决无线网络中的非独立同分布数据挑战。
en_tdlr: Proposes a communication-efficient Clustered Federated Learning framework that initializes model-based clustering via data-domain clustering, assigning clients to specialized models to tackle non-IID data in wireless networks without sharing raw data while reducing communication cost.
